source.author: verg
source.text: Turne, per has ego te lacrimas, per siquis Amatae tangit honos animum spes tu nunc una, senectae tu requies miserae, decus imperiumque Latini te penes, in te omnis domus inclinata recumbit.
source.text_original: 'Turne, per has ego te lacrimas, per siquis Amatae / tangit honos animum (spes tu nunc una, senectae / tu requies miserae, decus imperiumque Latini / te penes, in te omnis domus inclinata recumbit).
source.text_english: Turnus, by these tears of mine, by whatever honor of Amata touches your heart, you alone are now my hope, you my rest in my miserable old age; the glory and authority of Latinus are in your hands, on you my whole house leans, bent and resting.

reuse.author: hier
reuse.text: dicant, si uolunt, et grammatici: in te omnis domus inclinata recumbit.
reuse.text_original: dicant, si uolunt, et grammatici: in te omnis domus inclinata recumbit.
reuse.text_english: Let the grammarians say, if they wish: in you the whole house leans and rests.
